I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 56-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 5mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-02.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
